description: Maps buildings for a mapping campaign: draw them fast from the aerial imagery, give each its type, levels and dwellings, and see at a glance what is done. German by default.
highlights: A buildings map style after the kaligrafy iD fork: every building in red, its type in its own colour, the number of dwellings as an outline and a label
Building types first in the type picker and as suggested favourites; levels, levels underground and roof levels on every building
Drawing tools of the parking editor: rectangle with three clicks, right angles with lengths, extrude, resize, merge, cut, divide into row houses
Roads, paths, rail and water locked as context, so a building is not glued to a road
HOT Tasking Manager: a link `tm=<project>/<task>` opens a task, with its area on the map, its instructions in the dock and the project's changeset comment in the save form
